title: Framed
description: The guard has been asking questions on the jeweler's row and I want them asking somewhere else. Marcus the blacksmith delivered hinges to that street and owes the jeweler for scrap. He did nothing, which is why he fits.

objectives.description: Take jewelry from the jeweler's shop to plant on Marcus
Hide the jewelry in Marcus's home, where his family lives
Tell Raven the guard has a name to arrest

moral_choice.description: You can choose to plant the evidence or warn Marcus instead
moral_choice.good_option: Warn Marcus about the frame job

notes: Stealth and deception test. Jeweler and blacksmith should be in Dalhurst. Threat: Marcus, his wife and two children lose the forge and his freedom for a theft he had no part in. Giver motive: Raven needs the guard's suspicion pointed away from the Guild's own fence, and Marcus is convenient, not guilty of anything. Consequence: the moral_choice block (warn Marcus instead) is decorative - no choice_consequences entry exists and no dialogue action reads it, so mechanically there is only one path, the framing. A full fix needs a real second objective (warn_marcus) in an OR group with obj_plant_evidence, which this pass cannot add.
